derivation_note: DERIVED: tracks 'previous quantity per sku' in globalMap across rows (so the delta depends on row processing order) and calls the custom routine routines.InventoryRoutines.computeDelta (which itself calls formatDelta -- routine-calling-routine). The CRC32 math inside the routine is deterministic and was checked against com.sample.util.ChecksumUtil's compiled jar behavior (crc32Hex('SKU-2024-00123-A:120') computed by inspection of the CRC32 algorithm); the globalMap-keyed 'previous qty' state is what makes the block non-standalone.

cases.description: first time this sku is seen this run -> previous qty defaults to 0

expected_output._note: prev=0 (no globalMap entry yet) -> delta=+120; globalMap job12_prevQty_SKU-2024-00123-A set to 120

cases.description: same sku seen again later in the same run with a higher qty -> positive delta vs globalMap state
edge case: quantity decreased since last seen -> negative delta
